children: Orsted shares offer significant value at current levels, with the business maturing into an operating portfolio providing strong free cash flow yields, RBC Capital Markets analyst Alexander Wheeler writes. The company's portfolio maintains an average government-subsidy support of around 12 years, and while there is lower visibility on future growth, a strong balance sheet provides opportunities for growth and/or higher shareholder returns. The bank upgrades the stock to outperform from sector perform and raises its price target to 180 Danish kroner from 120 kroner. Shares rise 2.1% to 138.75 kroner. (dominic.chopping@wsj.com)
